name: REPLACE
description: REPLACE swaps out a specific number of characters in a text string, starting at a given position, with new text.

parameters.name: old_text
parameters.description: The original text or cell reference containing the text to modify.

parameters.name: start_num
parameters.description: The character position (1-based) at which to begin replacing.

parameters.name: num_chars
parameters.description: The number of characters in old_text to replace with new_text.

parameters.name: new_text
parameters.description: The text that replaces the specified characters.

basicExample.description: Replace the middle of a string
basicExample.explanation: Starting at position 2, three characters ("bcd") are replaced by "XYZ".

advancedExamples.title: Mask part of an account number
advancedExamples.explanation: Characters 4 through 7 are replaced with asterisks for a masked display.

advancedExamples.title: Insert text without removing any
advancedExamples.scenario: Add a dash after the first two characters of A1 = "AB1234"
advancedExamples.explanation: With num_chars set to 0, new_text is inserted at the position without deleting anything.

howItWorks: REPLACE identifies characters by position. It deletes num_chars characters beginning at start_num and inserts new_text in their place, then returns the rebuilt string.

howToSteps.name: Find the position
howToSteps.text: Note the 1-based index where the change begins.

howToSteps.name: Count characters
howToSteps.text: Decide how many characters to replace.

howToSteps.name: Write REPLACE
howToSteps.text: Enter =REPLACE(old, start, count, new) and press Enter.

limitations: Replacement is positional, so it does not search for matching text the way SUBSTITUTE does.
If start_num is beyond the text length the result may be unchanged or appended depending on version.
Doubles as an insertion tool only when num_chars is 0.

commonErrors.cause: start_num is less than 1 or num_chars is negative.
commonErrors.fix: Use a start_num of at least 1 and a non-negative num_chars.

commonErrors.cause: Off-by-one in start_num or miscounting num_chars.
commonErrors.fix: Remember positions are 1-based and count carefully.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: REPLACE works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: REPLACE vs SUBSTITUTE?
faq.answer: REPLACE changes characters by position; SUBSTITUTE replaces specific text you search for.

faq.question: Can REPLACE insert text?
faq.answer: Yes, set num_chars to 0 and new_text is inserted at start_num.
